about: Walk mode points: where a viewer can stand in each rendered room. Room metres as in conf18.py (x along the room from the door end, y = 0 on the facade, negative into the building). yaw: the first view, degrees from the screen wall (+x), positive to the right. Render each with: conf18.py --pano X,Y --res 3072x1536 --out media/skymark-f1/walk/<room>-<id>.jpg
